description: Integral homotopy classification of the first higher-independence (three-path-free) complex of the Möbius–Kantor graph.
integrity: Complete deterministic finite certificate with two independent face predicates, all directed Hasse incidences topologically sorted, and an auxiliary field-coefficient homology check; integral conclusion follows from the discrete-Morse CW model.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite 16-vertex graph and parameter two only; no infinite-family, equivariant or shellability conclusion. Full text of one same-graph topological preprint was inaccessible; unindexed equivalent priority cannot be excluded. No independent scientific audit.
title: The Möbius–Kantor two-independence complex is a wedge of three six-spheres
